nom: Earth Therapeutics Hydrogel Under-Eye Recovery Patch

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several say the patches caused no irritation and worked well, while one reports burning, redness and swelling and another notes mild itching despite liking the product overall.
segments.dry: Reviewers describing dry or chronically dry under-eye skin report noticeable hydration and softness, though one felt the patches were more drying than hydrating after 20 minutes.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 30s-40s mention reduced crow's feet, firmer under-eye skin, and softer fine lines with regular use.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines, crow's feet and creasing, and a smoother, firmer look under the eyes; no reviewer reports the patches worsening fine lines aside from two isolated 1-star complaints of new wrinkles appearing after use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say their under-eye skin feels hydrated, softer and less dry after use; a couple report the opposite, feeling dried out or crusty afterward.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with normally non-sensitive skin reports burning and redness within minutes of application, describing it as a clear sensitivity reaction.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers mention mild itching, tugging or a stiff feeling on removal that they attribute to the adhesive rather than irritation, while one describes ongoing burning and swelling on repeated use.

aspects.libelle: Good value for price versus premium brands

extraits.texte: I generally do not have sensitive eyes or skin. The first 2 times I used these it went fine. Cool and refreshing, puffiness significantly reduced. Smells great. Since then, every time I use them it is miserable. Eyes immediately burning, skin gets red and swollen within 1 to 2 minutes of placing them. Double checked instructions just to make sure I wasn't using them incorrectly and I was not. Just be careful if you have sensitive skin.
My skin is not sensitive what so ever and all it did was irritate my skin. The gel also isn't strong or feels like much cooling at all. I've used a few brands and this is one I won't purchase again.

extraits.titre: I've been a fan for years! These are awesome.
extraits.texte: Started using these in 2019 when I noticed a dry spot under one of my eyes and have used them regularly since then. This is a staple of my skincare regimen and make my undereyes look & feel amazing. For reference, I'm 40 w/sensitive skin.

I got these for my mom. Her eyes are very dry and dark. I feel like it brightened her eyes so much more and hydrated the dry area. It's also very cooling and relaxing. She looks like a little panda lol. I buy most of my products from Earth Therapeutics, so I'm not surprised they're so great. I seen a comment saying they fall of easy and aren't good. It has a side where it sticks very easily and good to the face. They must've not used it correctly or got their grimy hands on that side.

These are just ok. They have great ingredients and the patches adhere well to under eye area but after 20 minutes I felt like they were drying my under eye area more than hydrating them. Not very soothing overall. Would not repurchase.

36 yo... dont take care of myself well bc I'm too busy taking care of others. I've used clinique for years. I noticed in an anniversary pic just how much older my eyes are starting make me look!! I researched a couple different products. I originally wanted PTR gold patches but I cant afford that. I'm very happy with ET with green tea. My crow's feet are very minimal now. Under eye is so much more firm and less puffy. I read about some people complaining that they slip off. I put them on immediately after my shower and have had zero problems with slippage. I get dressed, blow dry my hair, eat dinner (work night shift), and then before I know it it's time to take them off. I dont write reviews, so me coming here is a big deal. I want other moms and women worrying about their skin to find something that makes them happy, even if just over some eye patches :)

A life saver during allergy season! I'll wear these for an hour while doing my hair, and my under eyes are significantly less puffy and moisturized. They are a little irritating and itch a little, but everyone's skin is different and the benefit outweighs the mild discomfort. I'm a repeat buyer!
